mentions.name: WPMaven.ai
mentions.description: This AI agent creates, runs, and grows a business for its owner: it handles all marketing, including UGC videos across social media, plus sales follow-up and closing sales. Owners can manage the business from WhatsApp, receive weekly reports on their phone, and approve or edit anything before it goes online.
mentions.audience: Business owners who describe their business and want marketing, sales, and operations handled for them.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Describe your business and WPMaven.ai creates it, runs it and grows it for you.
It does all your marketing, including UGC videos on all social media, sales follow-up and closes sales for you.
mentions.author: wpmaven
